title: Resolve integration and toolchain gates
scope: Record supported runtime/dependency versions and licenses.
Prove personal Project access, workflow OIDC identity and broker reachability with synthetic fixtures.
Probe the actual interactive client session identity/atomic guards and optional hook availability; define versioned hook-to-event normalization without making hooks mandatory.
first_verifiable_outcome: A recorded capability matrix and reproducible discovery commands; no real deploy.

title: Durable coordinator and operation model
scope: Implement migrations, typed states, intent/outbox and atomic claims.
Kill/restart a real process around each effect boundary.
Persist session observation and projection identity; prove missing/duplicate/late hook recovery and outbox retries without stale human-state overwrites.
first_verifiable_outcome: A queued synthetic operation resumes with its original ID after restart.

title: Configuration and GitHub request/projection adapter
scope: Compile configurable fields/rules and operator permissions.
Implement current-state reconciliation and non-destructive projections.
Use bounded personal-Project polling and one managed projection writer; keep human task/decision authority separate from operational records.
first_verifiable_outcome: A test Project field transition creates exactly one queued run.

title: SSH and independent workspace action
scope: Implement host enrollment, trusted helper and resource registry.
Create and reconcile independent source workspaces.
first_verifiable_outcome: Two issues have separate branches/directories and recover after connection loss.

title: Workflow broker, CI and delivery action
scope: Implement authenticated claims, receipt validation and dispatch reconciliation.
Recheck exact-revision CI/merge permissions; invoke own test deploy workflow.
first_verifiable_outcome: A test deployment is tied to the correct source and workflow revisions and verified target.

title: Directory cleanup action
scope: Implement policy eligibility, keep/quiescence and dirty/unpushed checks.
Implement safe target deletion with durable tombstones.
first_verifiable_outcome: One eligible directory is removed; blocked and unrelated paths remain intact.

title: CLI, installation and operations
scope: Implement operator diagnostics and pause/reconcile controls.
Exercise backup, upgrade and restore with unresolved external effects.
Package the CLI and single service together; diagnose optional hook/session compatibility without a hosting/control-panel dependency.
first_verifiable_outcome: A fresh operator can diagnose and recover a run without editing database rows.

title: Public examples and prerelease
scope: Validate a clean public install without private extensions.
Finish DCO, reporting route, contract SDK, examples and release evidence.
first_verifiable_outcome: A versioned prerelease with all P0 acceptance evidence and explicit platform limits.
